title: Detention and Prom
author: Wren Reyes
blurb: Wendell Thornbury, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
